# Orch term Documentation

> Public documentation for Orch term, a multi-agent terminal workstation for running and orchestrating AI coding agents such as Codex, Claude, and Agy from one local workspace.

Base URL: https://zendy00.github.io/orch-term-pages/

## Start Here

- [English overview](https://zendy00.github.io/orch-term-pages/en/)
- [English quickstart](https://zendy00.github.io/orch-term-pages/en/quickstart.html)
- [Korean overview](https://zendy00.github.io/orch-term-pages/)
- [Korean quickstart](https://zendy00.github.io/orch-term-pages/quickstart.html)

## Core Guides

- [Workstation](https://zendy00.github.io/orch-term-pages/en/workstation.html): workspace model, panes, and operator workflow.
- [Terminal](https://zendy00.github.io/orch-term-pages/en/terminal.html): terminal usage and local shells.
- [Orchestration](https://zendy00.github.io/orch-term-pages/en/orchestration.html): multi-agent sessions and worker coordination.
- [Sessions](https://zendy00.github.io/orch-term-pages/en/sessions.html): resuming past agent conversations, naming sessions, and automatic restore after an app restart.
- [Notes](https://zendy00.github.io/orch-term-pages/en/notes.html): floating notes with Markdown, drawings, sequence diagrams, and bidirectional Mermaid flowcharts.
- [Tasks](https://zendy00.github.io/orch-term-pages/en/tasks.html): task board and work tracking.
- [Task AI Sharing](https://zendy00.github.io/orch-term-pages/en/task-ai-sharing.html): sharing task context with AI agents.
- [Source Control](https://zendy00.github.io/orch-term-pages/en/source-control.html): git and source-control workflows.
- [SSH](https://zendy00.github.io/orch-term-pages/en/ssh.html): remote shell and SSH workflows.
- [Browser Mirror](https://zendy00.github.io/orch-term-pages/en/mirror.html): visible browser mirroring for web tasks.

## Discovery Files

- [Sitemap](https://zendy00.github.io/orch-term-pages/sitemap.xml)
- [Full LLM index](https://zendy00.github.io/orch-term-pages/llms-full.txt)

## Crawler Access

The site explicitly allows search and user-request crawlers for OpenAI, Google, and Anthropic in `robots.txt`, including OAI-SearchBot, ChatGPT-User, Googlebot, Google-Extended, Claude-SearchBot, and Claude-User. Training crawlers GPTBot and ClaudeBot are also allowed.
